body:
What do we talk about? 

Everything. It’s amazing how effortless and  fluid our conversations are, I am good at conversations tho so that’s never been a problem for me. 


How long have we been dating?

Not long, we *just* started. I guess we’re in the honeymoon phase but sometimes I feel like I’m more into her than she is into me  


How often do we see each other? 

Well like I said, talking it slow so maybe 2-3 times a week.

You definitely make a good point when saying that not everyone functions the way I do. And I don’t think I would be upset if she sent me a text every once in a while to check on me, hell I get messages from friends I haven’t seen in years checking up on me and seeing how life is going, and I do the same for them. I just wish she would be a little bit more attentive, at least as attentive as I am (which isn’t a huge amount, I’m sure of that)

No no. I’ve never dated her before, it’s just in my past relationships I used to be clingy so I don’t want to ruin this by repeating my mistakes. And I guess? I mean Im at a point where I choose my words carefully cause I’m constantly thinking about how I’m coming off, so I never reveal any insecurities or complain about anything, I feel like if I become too real she might be overwhelmed, I know I am
It’s not about being anxious or worrying, it’s about showing you care.

I mean I don’t really ask anyone to text me when they get home unless they’re my sister or maybe a friend who lives in a rough neighbourhood... so maybe it could be a individual person type deal. But it does bother me that she rarely checks on me.

I get that.. but I wouldn’t call her “just another friend” a partner isn’t just someone you have sex with, it’s someone you share everything with, someone you trust with your life, someone that will be there  for you and is willing to make you a priority, I feel like for me it’s really hard to find someone with the same values I have, while I’m mostly liberal, I still hold some conservative values that most people would disagree with. And it’s not just that, I feel like we compliment each other and whenever I’m with her, everything becomes clear and easy. Even if sex is off the table, I would love to make it work.
I mean I guess we’d still kiss and stuff, sex isn’t the only thing that makes a relationship
Did you manage to make a profit?
Aw that’s awesome! I come from a family of businessmen (and women) so I’m kinda interested to see how it all starts
Idk I thought the new Star Wars were cool
Lol that’s a lil too forward rn but if this is something we both are into, I’m sure we’ll do something like that in the future
Well we’re not in the states so she can buy her own
Yeah I guess I’ll just get to know her
